m3-tourn1.title: Tournament (Hard)
m3-tourn1.html:
Tournament

Five neighbourhood futsal sides — Rovers, Strikers, Comets, Titans, Wanderers — played a single round-robin: each pair met exactly once. A win was worth 2 points, a draw 1 point, and a loss 0.

The following is known:

  • Strikers finished with 1 points.
  • Comets finished with 2 points.
  • Titans finished with 6 points.
  • Rovers finished with 3 points.
  • Comets won exactly one match.

m3-linear2.title: Arrangement (Medium)
m3-linear2.html:
Arrangement

Six cyclists finish a hill-climb race in positions 1 to 6 with no ties (position 1 is first). Each rides a bike of one of three colours — teal, maroon, ivory — with exactly two bikes of each colour.

The following is known:

  • Tara's bike colour is not maroon.
  • The bike in position 5 is not ivory.
  • Chirag's bike colour is teal.
  • Nakul's bike colour is not maroon.
  • Nakul and Tara are in adjacent positions.
  • Faiz is not in position 3.
  • Chirag is not in position 3.
  • Exactly three positions lie strictly between Farah's and Tara's.
  • Chirag is in a lower-numbered position than Faiz.
  • Exactly one position lies strictly between Ojas's and Chirag's.
  • Faiz's bike colour is not maroon.

m3-circular3.title: Circular arrangement (Hard)
m3-circular3.html:
Circular arrangement

Seven colleagues sit around a circular table at a team lunch, equally spaced and facing the centre. Each orders one of three drinks — buttermilk, lemon soda, cold coffee — with three people choosing buttermilk and two each choosing the others. "Immediately to the left" is from the seated person's own point of view.

The following is known:

  • Jatin and Meera sit next to each other.
  • Along the shorter way round, exactly two people sit between Divya and Gautam.
  • Gautam's drink is not buttermilk.
  • Along the shorter way round, exactly two people sit between Arjun and Bhavin.
  • Meera sits immediately to the left of Arjun.
  • Arjun sits immediately to the left of Divya.
  • Arjun and Bhavin have different drinks.
  • Meera's drink is not buttermilk.
  • Jatin's drink is not lemon soda.
  • Divya and Arjun have the same drink.
  • Jatin and Gautam have the same drink.

m3-group4.title: Grouping & selection (Hard)
m3-group4.html:
Grouping & selection

Seven volunteers are posted to three relief camps: Camp North gets three volunteers, Camp River and Camp Hill get two each. Exactly three of the seven are trained medics; the rest are not (call them senior and junior respectively). The seven are Manav, Charu, Faiz, Lavanya, Pallavi, Eshan, Wamiq.

The following is known:

  • Pallavi is not in Camp North.
  • Faiz and Pallavi are in the same team.
  • Lavanya is senior.
  • Every teammate of Pallavi is junior.
  • Camp River has exactly one senior member.
  • Charu and Wamiq are in different teams.
  • Manav is senior.
  • Faiz is not in Camp Hill.
  • Lavanya and Eshan are in the same team.
